records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total net revenue for the three and six months ended June 30, 2025 decreased by $101.1 million, or 2%, and $286.4 million, or 2% compared to the three and six months ended June 30, 2024, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Subscription and services-based revenue for the three and six months ended June 30, 2025 increased by $264.7 million, or 15%, and $473.4 million, or 14%, compared to the three and six months ended June 30, 2024, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the second quarter of 2025, we generated gross profit of $2.5 billion, up 14% year over year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in the three and six months ended June 30, 2025 was driven by a decrease in trading volume, partially offset by an increase in the average market price of bitcoin, compared to the three and six months ended June 30, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the second quarter of 2025, operating income was $484.3 million and Adjusted Operating Income was $549.6 million, compared to operating income of $306.6 million and Adjusted Operating Income of $399.1 million in the second quarter of 2024.
